sections.text: Theme: How Smart Are Carnivores?[8]Item #1: Dogs have twice the neuronal density as cats.Item #2: On average domesticated species have significantly lower neuronal density than their wild counterparts.Item #3: Contrary to what the researchers expected to find, carnivorous species did not have greater neuronal density than prey species.Item #4: The racoon was an outlier among the carnivores, with a neuronal density equal to that of primates.
Magnificent desolation.– American astronaut Buzz Aldrin's first words upon setting foot on the moon
